events.description: A clock face is displayed with a running clock animation, and a ladybug SVGMobject flies in along a smooth path to land on the 12 o'clock tick mark.
events.clip_query: A ladybug lands on a clock face

events.description: The ladybug begins a random walk, moving clockwise or counterclockwise between clock ticks with yellow arrows indicating the step direction.
events.clip_query: A ladybug walking randomly along the numbers of a clock

events.description: Visited numbers on the clock turn red, and the final unvisited number turns teal when the ladybug lands on it, completing the walk.
events.clip_query: The last number on the clock turns teal as the ladybug visits it
